newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAFRICA'S Q DATA BUYS MAPS & DATA.
newsitem.headline: SAFRICA'S Q DATA BUYS MAPS & DATA.

text.p: South African group Q Data said on Tuesday that it had bought a controlling share in Johannesburg-based firm Maps & Data for an undisclosed sum.
The firm said the buy moved the group into the fast-growing business mapping industry, which aids the analysis of sales data and marketing information.

"We see the acquisition as the platform to launch Maps & Data into markets we have previously not addressed as well as consolidating our leadership position in existing markets," said Maps & Data director Anthony Poorter.
